@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+package main
+
+import (
+	"os"
+	"regexp"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+// The example checks out px1 and runs it with the caller's API key, so it must
+// name an immutable commit, never a branch or tag that can move.
+func TestCIExamplePinsPx1ToACommitSHA(t *testing.T) {
+	data, err := os.ReadFile("examples/px1-agentic-review.yml")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	refs := regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^\s+ref:\s*(\S+)`).FindAllStringSubmatch(string(data), -1)
+	if len(refs) != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("want exactly one px1 ref, found %d", len(refs))
+	}
+	if !regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{40}$`).MatchString(refs[0][1]) {
+		t.Fatalf("px1 ref %q must be a full 40-character commit SHA", refs[0][1])
+	}
+}

explanations.title: Enforce immutable refs
explanations.summary: The test fails if the example no longer has exactly one px1 ref or if that ref is not a full commit SHA, guarding against accidentally switching back to a movable branch or tag.

explanations.title: Pin the px1 checkout
explanations.summary: The workflow now checks out a fixed px1 revision instead of following a branch, so changes to px1 cannot silently alter code that runs with the repository’s API key.
